title: Great
text: Great. I have already canned a couple of batches of peaches in this and it works great. It's my first time canning on my own and this canner works just fine.

product_metadata.title: Granite Ware Enamel on Steel 15.5-Quart Water Bath Canner with lid & Jar Rack, Multiuse Pot, Resistant & Easy to Clean
features: MULTIUSE POT: Use canner as a Stock Pot.
EASY TO HANDLE JAR RACK: Includes rust-proof chromed steel rack that holds 4 1-Quart jars, 7 pint jars & 7 one-half pint jars; jars not included.
EVENLY DISTRIBUTES HEAT: Porcelain surface with durable steel core provides excellent heat distribution, reducing heat up time and saving energy.
USE & CARE: Dishwasher safe, NOT recommended for glass cooktops.
